name: @solidjs/signals
reason: The packages of a Solid release move together, and @solidjs/compiler has no 2.0.3, so every Solid package stays on 2.0.2, the newest release all four share.
liftWhen: @solidjs/compiler publishes 2.0.3 or later and it is old enough to install.

name: @vitest/browser-playwright
reason: vite-plus 1.7.0, its newest release, depends on vitest 5.1.0 exactly and asks for @vitest/browser-playwright 5.1.0 as its peer, so 5.1.1 installs a second vitest, 5.1.1, beside the one vp test runs.
liftWhen: A vite-plus release old enough to install depends on vitest 5.1.1 or later.
